inspection.reviewer: Delegated assistant after original/source/export light/dark/checkerboard, both helper sizes and all eight current surfaces at both sizes; independent UX original-source review

checks.name: identity
checks.observation: Supported one-arm dumbbell row is recognizable near the top of the pull, with one bent pulling arm beside the torso and a separate straight support arm.

checks.name: style-consistency
checks.observation: Previously inspected approved front-plank person/style retained: blue-gray top, terracotta leggings, bun, natural adult proportions and restrained educational shading; plain gray shoes/bench/weight.

checks.name: pose-and-contact
checks.observation: Flat support palm and bent knee visibly meet the bench pad. The separate pulling hand grips one dumbbell near the lower ribs; supporting shin/foot extends behind the knee and the other complete shoe appears planted. Back/neck are plausible and continuous. No duplicate/disconnected limb or material floating-contact defect observed. Independent source review agrees.

checks.name: equipment-continuity
checks.observation: Exactly one gray hex dumbbell has a continuous handle/two matching ends and a visible wrapped hand grip. Horizontal bench pad, frame, angled legs and feet are continuous and fully contained; no disconnected equipment or invented weight label observed.

checks.name: decoded-alpha
checks.observation: Viewed original/source/export light/dark and decoded checkerboard: clean transparency around/between person, dumbbell and bench; no distracting matte, colored fringe or visibly clipped extremity. Complete bun outline remains within the source.

checks.name: small-usage-and-containment
checks.observation: Viewed source/runtime helper panels at 256x144 and 320x180 plus both-size all-eight current-container composites. Support hand/knee, pulling arm/weight and standing shoe remain recognizable. Full figure and bench remain contained; fine finger/contact detail is clearer enlarged.

checks.name: interface-remnants
checks.observation: No weight number, text, labels, arrows, scenery, branding, UI, phone frame or watermark observed. The user's unspecified row weight is not invented.

limitations: Top clearance is very tight: visible alpha>=128 bbox [366,7,1324,913] on 1672x941 gives approximately 1.3dp above and 5.4dp below at180dp height. Bun outline is complete; generous margins are not achieved.
No exact elbow angle, spinal/shoulder alignment or clinical exercise-form validation claimed. Equipment observations do not mechanically certify the bench/dumbbell.
Untagged source explicitly interpreted as sRGB under profile; no embedded-profile measurement or conversion claimed.
Deterministic boards use current presentation.json colors; actual native/RN rendering, measured text/control contrast and signed-phone acceptance remain separate.
Review is technical/visual only. Root records and binds the owner's standing artwork/activation approval; this reviewer performs no production promotion.
